closed_issue.known: R41 is 330 ohm to J1 VPP. The switch-side node also reaches R40 and C35; opposite C35 side is GND.
closed_issue.unknown: Internal contact pairings and released/pressed behavior of this switch have not been measured.
closed_issue.next_action: B38-B41 on the labelled S1 screen: A-B and C-D released, then B-D released and held pressed. These distinguish internal common contacts and switching behavior without repeating PCB routing.
closed_issue.closed_when: Same-row pairs and open/closed switching agree with the drawing, or the switch pin mapping is corrected.
closed_issue.owner: Agent evidence review; targeted owner test only as listed

resolution.result: B38-B41: A-B and C-D each 1 ohm; B-D released OL and held pressed 1 ohm. Confirms normally-open S1 with physical TL/TR common on GND (native pin1) and BL/BR common on H_BUTTON (native pin2). Additional A-C OL retained as reported. R41 reaches J1 VPP through the existing 330-ohm path. Contact issue E05 closed; exact footprint fit and the measured 6-mm housing remain separate mechanical qualifications.

limits: This verifies electrical contact behavior, not exact manufacturer, ratings, pad fit or 3D housing.
The 1-ohm readings include probe and contact resistance; no intrinsic switch-contact resistance is inferred.
